title: Concept: Predictable randomness via sample (r) — review required
description: In r, sample is a statistical generator, not a cryptographic one: observing outputs reveals the state, and default seeds repeat across runs. Security values need unpredictability, which only a cryptographic source provides in r.
applicability: r codebases drawing random values through sample; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Guessed session tokens, reset links, and nonces when predictable output guards access; MEDIUM severity, HIGH when the value directly authenticates.
